# Master Step-by-Step Execution Plan (`plan.md`) — Sri Lankan Cloud SaaS Hotel Management System & Contactless QR Room Service Platform

## Document Scope, 3-Repository GitHub Codespaces Architecture, Full Production SaaS Entity Model & Apple HIG Design Mandate

This master execution specification contains the complete **GitHub Codespaces 3-repository workspace setup**, **pre-flight coding & Apple Design UI/UX skill optimization stack**, **Sri Lankan hospitality statutory tax & compliance formulas**, **42-entity production multi-tenant SaaS DynamoDB & GraphQL schemas**, **Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) & Liquid Glass design system**, **independent Backend & Frontend GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows**, and **500 sequential, checkbox-tracked Antigravity CLI (`agy`) prompts** to build a full-scale multi-tenant Cloud SaaS Hotel Management System (HMS) and Contactless QR Room Service platform purpose-built for Sri Lankan hotels, resorts, boutique villas, and rest houses.

- **GitHub Codespaces 3-Repository Workspace Architecture (`Sri-Lanka--HMS` + `HMS-Backend` + `HMS-Frontend`)**:
  - **Primary Codespaces Workspace / Orchestrator Repository**: [https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/Sri-Lanka--HMS](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FPasanRamyanath%2FSri-Lanka--HMS) (mounted at `/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS`). Houses `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` ([GitHub Codespaces Multi-Repo Configuration](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fcodespaces-contrib%2Fcodespaces-multi-repo)), this master `plan.md` checklist, `.antigravity/rules.md`, and cross-repo verification scripts.
  - **First Action Inside GitHub Codespaces (`Step 001` & `postCreateCommand`)**: Immediately clones the two application repositories directly into `/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/`:
    1. **Backend Repository (`HMS-Backend`)**: [https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/HMS-Backend](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FPasanRamyanath%2FHMS-Backend) (`/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Backend`) — Houses `@hms/core` (pure Sri Lankan 4-stage tax, NIC/Passport, LankaQR, PayHere, WebXPay, Channex, FIFO inventory, and EPF/ETF/SC payroll domain engine), `@hms/graphql` (42-entity GraphQL schema, direct AppSync JS resolvers, and TypeScript/Flutter contract exporter), and `@hms/cdk` (AWS CDK v2 serverless stack in `ap-south-1` Mumbai). Every push to `main` triggers `HMS-Backend/.github/workflows/deploy-backend.yml` using keyless [AWS IAM OIDC (aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4)](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Faws-actions%2Fconfigure-aws-credentials).
    2. **Frontend Repository (`HMS-Frontend`)**: [https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/HMS-Frontend](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FPasanRamyanath%2FHMS-Frontend) (`/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Frontend`) — Houses the React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 web platform built to [Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG)](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdesign%2Fhuman-interface-guidelines) and [Apple Liquid Glass](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdocumentation%2Ftechnologyoverviews%2Fliquid-glass) standards (`src/qr/` Zero-Login Contactless Guest QR PWA, `src/staff/` Smartphone KDS/BOT/POS/Housekeeping apps, and `src/admin/` Full Multi-Tenant Hotel PMS, ERP & Super-Admin portal). Every push to `main` independently triggers `HMS-Frontend/.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml` to lint, test, build, sync to Amazon S3, and invalidate Amazon CloudFront.
- **Complete 42-Entity Production Multi-Tenant SaaS Data Model**:
  - Covers every entity required for a live commercial SaaS application: SaaS Organizations, Hotel Tenants, SaaS Subscriptions & Entitlements, SaaS Billing Invoices, Webhook Endpoints, API Keys, Staff Users, RBAC Permission Matrices, Staff Shift Sessions, Hash-Chained Immutable Audit Logs, Room Types, Physical Rooms, Rate Plans, Seasonal Rate Calendars, Promotions/Vouchers, Chauffeur/Driver Dorm Beds, Guest CRM Profiles, Tour Operator / DMC Corporate Accounts, Reservations, Per-Room Stay Locks, Room Maintenance Blocks, Tourist Police B-Cards, Master/Split Guest Folios, Folio Line Items, Payment/Refund Transactions, Cashier Shift Drawers, IRD RAMIS Commercial Tax Invoices, Dining Outlets, Menu Categories, Menu Items, QR Location Endpoints, Service Orders, Housekeeping Tasks, Minibar/Laundry Logs, Engineering Work Orders, Lost & Found Register, Banquet Halls & Wedding BEOs, Ayurveda Spa Appointments, Excursion/Airport Transfers, Suppliers & Store Stock SKUs, Procurement Vouchers (`PR`/`PO`/`GRN`/`GIN`), Night Audit Snapshots, SLTDA Monthly/Quarterly Returns, and Monthly Staff EPF/ETF/Service-Charge Payroll.
- **Apple Human Interface Guidelines (Apple HIG) & Liquid Glass UI/UX Across Every Screen**:
  - Every Guest QR, Staff Mobile KDS/POS/HK, and Hotel PMS Admin interface adheres to [Apple Human Interface Guidelines](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdesign%2Fhuman-interface-guidelines), [Apple Liquid Glass](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdocumentation%2Ftechnologyoverviews%2Fliquid-glass), and [Apple Materials \& Vibrancy](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdesign%2Fhuman-interface-guidelines%2Fmaterials): translucent frosted vibrancy surfaces (`backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%)`), specular `1px` top/left borders, SF Pro / `system-ui` optical typography hierarchy with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` for LKR currency and folio columns, continuous squircle corner radii (`14px` / `20px` / `28px`), natural spring physics (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), `>= 44x44pt` touch targets, `⌘K` Spotlight command bar, and WCAG AAA dark/light mode contrast with `@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce)` solid fallbacks.
- **Human-Understandable Code & Zero Console/Dead-Code Noise (No Arbitrary Line Budgets)**:
  - **No Code Line (LOC) Budget Restrictions**: Every module, resolver, Lambda, and React component is written for **maximum human readability, clear intent, and self-documenting structure**—never cramped or golfed to fit an arbitrary line count.
  - **Strict Anti-Noise & Zero-Slop Enforcement**: Enforces **zero `console.log` / `console.error` / `console.warn` / `debugger` statements** in application code (via [Biome suspicious.noConsole: "error"](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fbiomejs.dev%2Flinter%2Frules%2Fno-console%2Fjavascript%2F) and `suspicious.noDebugger: "error"`), **zero unused imports/variables/exports/files** (via [Knip](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fknip.dev%2F) and Biome `correctness.noUnusedVariables: "error"`), **low cognitive complexity** (`maxAllowedComplexity: 12`), and the [Ponytail](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fdietrichgebert%2Fponytail) + [Addy Osmani's agent-skills](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Faddyosmani%2Fagent-skills%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fdocs%2Fantigravity-setup.md) clarity rulesets.
- **Mandatory Step-by-Step Git Commit, Push & Checkbox Protocol**:
  - Every step (`Step 001` through `Step 500`) includes a completion checkbox (`- [ ] Step XXX`).
  - **Strict Sequential Gate**: `agy` must **never** advance to `Step N+1` until `Step N` passes all automated checks (`npx biome check . && npx knip && npm test`), its checkbox is updated from `- [ ]` to `- [x]` in `/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/plan.md` and the target repository's `PROGRESS.md`, and the implementation is committed (`git commit -m "feat(step-XXX): ..."`) and pushed (`git push origin main`) to its GitHub remote (`PasanRamyanath/HMS-Backend`, `PasanRamyanath/HMS-Frontend`, or `PasanRamyanath/Sri-Lanka--HMS`).
- **Near-Free-Tier AWS CDK Operation (`ap-south-1` Mumbai)**: All cloud resources are provisioned via **AWS CDK v2 (TypeScript)** in `ap-south-1` (~25 ms RTT from Sri Lanka) within permanent [AWS Free Tier](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Faws.amazon.com%2Ffree%2F) allowances: [AWS AppSync GraphQL](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Faws.amazon.com%2Fappsync%2Fpricing%2F), [Amazon DynamoDB Single-Table (20 RCU / 20 WCU Provisioned Always Free)](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Faws.amazon.com%2Fdynamodb%2Fpricing%2F), [AWS Lambda Node.js 22 ARM64 Graviton2](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Faws.amazon.com%2Flambda%2Fpricing%2F), [Amazon Cognito](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Faws.amazon.com%2Fcognito%2Fpricing%2F), and [Amazon S3 + CloudFront (1 TB/month Always Free)](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Faws.amazon.com%2Ffree%2F).

### 0.1: GitHub Codespaces Multi-Repository `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` (`/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`)

When you open [https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/Sri-Lanka--HMS](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FPasanRamyanath%2FSri-Lanka--HMS) in GitHub Codespaces, this configuration automatically grants read/write repository permissions to `HMS-Backend` and `HMS-Frontend`, clones both repositories into `/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/`, and installs all AGY CLI plugins and Apple Design UI/UX skills:

```json
{
  "name": "Sri Lanka HMS SaaS — 3-Repo Antigravity Codespace",
  "image": "mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/typescript-node:1-22-bookworm",
  "features": {
    "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/aws-cli:1": {},
    "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/github-cli:1": {}
  },
  "customizations": {
    "codespaces": {
      "repositories": {
        "PasanRamyanath/Sri-Lanka--HMS": {
          "permissions": "write-all"
        },
        "PasanRamyanath/HMS-Backend": {
          "permissions": "write-all"
        },
        "PasanRamyanath/HMS-Frontend": {
          "permissions": "write-all"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "postCreateCommand": "bash .devcontainer/bootstrap-three-repos.sh",
  "forwardPorts": [5173, 4000]
}
```

#### `.devcontainer/bootstrap-three-repos.sh` (First Action Executed in GitHub Codespaces)

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS

# 1. Clone HMS-Backend and HMS-Frontend first into the Codespaces workspace
if [ ! -d "/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Backend/.git" ]; then
  git clone https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/HMS-Backend.git /workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Backend
fi

if [ ! -d "/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Frontend/.git" ]; then
  git clone https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/HMS-Frontend.git /workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Frontend
fi

# 2. Install Antigravity CLI (agy) Coding & Apple HIG UI/UX Skills
agy plugin install https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail || true
agy plugin install https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills.git || true
npx --yes skills add dickwu/apple-design-skill -a antigravity || true
npx --yes skills add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill -a antigravity || true
npx --yes agentic-awesome-skills --agy || true
```

## Part I: Sri Lankan Hospitality Domain Research & Statutory Compliance Matrix

### 1.1: Four-Stage Compounding Sri Lankan Hotel Tax Formula ([IRD \& SLTDA Verified](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Finduwara.lk%2Ftools%2Fsri-lanka-hotel-bill-tax-calculator))

Unlike flat-tax jurisdictions, Sri Lankan hotel invoices follow a mandatory **four-stage compounding gross-up** governed by the [Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA)](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sltda.gov.lk%2Ftourism-development-levy), the Department of Labour (Shop and Office Employees Act), and the [Inland Revenue Department (IRD)](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ird.gov.lk%2Fen%2FType%2520of%2520Taxes%2FSitePages%2FSocial%2520Security%2520Contribution%2520Levy%2520%28SSCL%29.aspx). Every property tenant in the SaaS database stores independent boolean toggles (`enableSC`, `enableTDL`, `enableSSCL`, `enableVAT`) and statutory registration numbers (`sltdaRegNo`, `tinNo`, `vatRegNo`, `ssclRegNo`) so properties of any size—from a 5-room Ella homestay to a 200-room Bentota beach resort—compute legally compliant invoices:

| Computation Stage | Line Item Code | Statutory Rate | Exact Mathematical Formula | Sri Lankan Accounting & Legal Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage 0 (Base)** | `BASE_SUPPLY` ($B$) | — | $B = \text{Room} + \text{F\&B} + \text{Spa} + \text{Extras} - \text{Discounts}$ | All tax invoices must be locked in **Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR)**. Foreign currency bookings (`USD`, `EUR`, `GBP`) convert to `LKR` using the locked check-in exchange rate. |
| **Stage 1 (SC)** | `SERVICE_CHARGE` ($SC$) | `10.0%` (or `0%` if no pool) | $SC = \text{round}(B \times 0.10, 2)$ | Governed by the Shop & Office Employees Act. **Not hotel revenue**—posted to the `STAFF_SC_POOL` liability ledger for monthly staff distribution (after configurable 5%–10% breakage deduction). Running subtotal: $A = B + SC$. |
| **Stage 2 (TDL)** | `TDL_LEVY` ($TDL$) | `1.0%` (or `0.5%` small tier) | $TDL = \text{round}(A \times r_{\text{TDL}}, 2)$ | Governed by [Section 50 of the Tourism Act No. 38 of 2005 / Finance Act No. 25 of 2003](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sltda.gov.lk%2Ftourism-development-levy). Rate is `1.0%` on $A$ (`0.5%` if annual turnover $\le$ LKR 12M or quarterly $\le$ LKR 3M). Remitted to SLTDA BOC Corporate Branch A/C `73104820` or via GovPay. |
| **Stage 3 (SSCL)** | `SSCL_LEVY` ($SSCL$) | `2.5%` (if turnover $>$ LKR 60M/qtr) | $SSCL = \text{round}(A \times 0.025, 2)$ | Governed by [SSCL Act No. 25 of 2022](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ird.gov.lk%2Fen%2FType%2520of%2520Taxes%2FSitePages%2FSocial%2520Security%2520Contribution%2520Levy%2520%28SSCL%29.aspx). Computed on the post-SC subtotal $A$ (parallel with TDL). Omitted for small properties below the LKR 60M quarterly threshold. |
| **Stage 4 (VAT)** | `VAT_TAX` ($VAT$) | `18.0%` (if turnover $>$ LKR 60M/yr) | $VAT_{\text{base}} = A + TDL + SSCL$<br>$VAT = \text{round}(VAT_{\text{base}} \times 0.18, 2)$ | Effective 1 January 2024 (Extraordinary Gazette No. 2364/22). Under IRD practice, the VAT base includes $TDL$ and $SSCL$. Full multiplier when all 4 apply: $G = B \times 1.10 \times 1.035 \times 1.18 = B \times 1.34343$ (`34.343%` effective loading). |
| **Reverse Mode** | `INCLUSIVE_DERIVE` | Multiplier $m$ | $m = (1 + r_{\{SC\}}) \times (1 + r_{\{TDL\}} + r_{\{SSCL\}}) \times (1 + r_{\{VAT\}})$<br>$B = \text{round}(G / m, 2)$ | When a travel agent or OTA quotes an "All-Inclusive LKR 50,000" gross rate ($G$), the engine derives $B = G / m$, computes forward stages, and reconciles any $\pm 0.01$ or $\pm 1.03$ rupee rounding delta on the $VAT$ line so the printed lines sum to $G$. |

### 1.2: Sri Lankan Payment Gateways, LankaQR EMVCo & Local SMS Gateways

1. **[PayHere Checkout \& Recurring API](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fsupport.payhere.lk%2Fapi-%26-mobile-sdk%2Fcheckout-api)**:
   - Primary LKR & USD checkout aggregator supporting Visa, Mastercard, Amex, FriMi, Dialog Genie, eZ Cash, mCash, Vishwa, and HelaPay ([Sri Lanka Payment Gateway Guide](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fsynthora.lk%2Fblog%2Fpayment-gateway-sri-lanka-guide)).
   - **Action Endpoints**: Live `https://www.payhere.lk/pay/checkout` (must include `www.` to avoid error `PH-0022`) and Sandbox `https://sandbox.payhere.lk/pay/checkout`.
   - **Server-Side Checkout Hash**:
     $$\text{hash} = \text{UPPER}\left(\text{MD5}\left(\text{merchant\_id} \mathbin{\Vert} \text{order\_id} \mathbin{\Vert} \text{formatAmount}(\text{amount}) \mathbin{\Vert} \text{currency} \mathbin{\Vert} \text{UPPER}(\text{MD5}(\text{merchant\_secret}))\right)\right)$$
   - **Webhook Verification (`notify_url`)**: Parses `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` body (`merchant_id`, `order_id`, `payment_id`, `payhere_amount`, `payhere_currency`, `status_code`, `md5sig`, `method`, `card_no`), recomputes `local_md5sig`, and marks payment settled only when `local_md5sig === md5sig && status_code === "2"`.
2. **[WebXPay](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fwebxpay.com%2F)**:
   - Used for recurring monthly SaaS subscription billing of Sri Lankan hotels (`STARTER_VILLA`, `PRO_RESORT`, `ENTERPRISE_CHAIN`) and tokenized B2B corporate settlement links.
3. **[LankaQR EMVCo Merchant-Presented Mode (MPM) Standard](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.barcoder.ai%2Fdocs%2Fstandards%2Flankaqr)**:
   - Operated by LankaPay (CEFTS rail) under Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) oversight across 21 Sri Lankan banks and interoperable with **Alipay+** for inbound Asian tourists.
   - Dynamic room-bill and table-bill QR payloads encode TLV tags: `00` (`01`), `01` (`12` dynamic), `26`–`51` (Merchant Account Info), `52` (MCC `7011` Lodging / `5812` Restaurants), `53` (`144` LKR ISO 4217 numeric), `54` (Exact LKR amount), `58` (`LK`), `59` (Hotel Name), `60` (City, e.g., `Galle`, `Kandy`, `Pelmadulla`), `62/05` (Reference ID `FOLIO-1021`), and `63` (4-hex CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE checksum).
4. **[SMSGo.lk](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fsmsgo.lk%2Fdevelopers%2Fapi) & [Notify.lk](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.notify.lk%2Ffrequently-asked-questions%2F) Tier-1 SS7 SMS Gateways**:
   - Dispatches instant OTPs (`POST https://api.smsgo.lk/api/v1/otp/send`), guest check-in QR links, chauffeur/driver room ready alerts, and payment receipts across Dialog, Mobitel, Hutch, and Airtel using header `X-API-Key` and delivery webhook signature `X-SMSGo-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256).

### 1.3: Channex.io OTA Channel Manager Integration ([Channex API v1](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.channex.io%2Fapi-v.1-documentation%2Fwebhook-collection))

- Synchronizes Availability, Rates, and Inventory (`ARI`) with **Booking.com**, **Agoda** (critical for Sri Lankan inbound & domestic market), **Expedia**, and **Airbnb**.
- **Webhook Security**: Validates `x-hmac-timestamp` ($\le 300\text{s}$ replay window) and `x-hmac-signature-256` computed as `lowercase_hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<raw_request_body>"))` over raw unparsed request bytes using `crypto.timingSafeEqual`, supporting dual-signature key rotation (`current,pending`).
- **Pull & Acknowledge Pattern**: On receiving `booking_new`, `booking_modification`, or `booking_cancellation`, the Lambda handler fetches `GET /api/v1/booking_revisions/:revision_id`, maps OTA room/rate codes to local `RoomType` and `MealPlan`, writes the reservation into DynamoDB, and acknowledges the revision before the 30-minute `non_acked_booking` timeout.

### 2.2: Independent GitHub Actions CI/CD Workflows (`PasanRamyanath/HMS-Backend` & `PasanRamyanath/HMS-Frontend`)

#### Backend Repository Workflow (`HMS-Backend/.github/workflows/deploy-backend.yml`)

```yaml
name: Deploy HMS-Backend (AWS CDK ap-south-1)
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify-and-deploy-backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PasanRamyanath/HMS-Backend
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js 22 LTS
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Enforce Zero Console Errors, Lint & Formatting (Biome)
        run: npx biome ci .

      - name: Enforce Zero Dead Code & Unused Exports (Knip)
        run: npx knip

      - name: Run 42-Entity Domain & Lambda Unit Tests + Free-Tier Cost Guardrails
        run: npm test

      - name: Compile AppSync JS Resolvers & Synthesize CDK Stack
        run: npm run codegen && npm run synth

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials via OIDC (Main Branch Only)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_BACKEND_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ap-south-1

      - name: Deploy AWS CDK Backend Stack
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
        run: npx --workspace=@hms/cdk cdk deploy --all --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json
```

#### Frontend Repository Workflow (`HMS-Frontend/.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml`)

```yaml
name: Deploy HMS-Frontend (S3 + CloudFront ap-south-1)
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify-and-deploy-frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      VITE_APPSYNC_HTTP_URL: ${{ vars.VITE_APPSYNC_HTTP_URL }}
      VITE_APPSYNC_WS_URL: ${{ vars.VITE_APPSYNC_WS_URL }}
      VITE_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID }}
      VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID }}
      VITE_AWS_REGION: ap-south-1
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PasanRamyanath/HMS-Frontend
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js 22 LTS
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Enforce Zero Console Statements, Lint & Formatting (Biome)
        run: npx biome ci .

      - name: Enforce Zero Unused Components, Hooks & Dependencies (Knip)
        run: npx knip

      - name: Typecheck & Run Frontend Unit + Accessibility Tests
        run: npx tsc --noEmit && npm test

      - name: Build Apple HIG Production Bundles (Guest QR + Staff PWA + Admin PMS)
        run: npm run build

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials via OIDC (Main Branch Only)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_FRONTEND_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ap-south-1

      - name: Sync Hashed Assets to S3 & Invalidate CloudFront Entrypoint
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          aws s3 sync dist/assets "s3://${{ vars.HMS_FRONTEND_S3_BUCKET }}/assets" --cache-control "public,max-age=31536000,immutable" --delete
          aws s3 cp dist/index.html "s3://${{ vars.HMS_FRONTEND_S3_BUCKET }}/index.html" --cache-control "no-cache,no-store,must-revalidate"
          aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id "${{ vars.HMS_CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID }}" --paths "/index.html" "/sw.js" "/manifest.json"
```

### 2.3: Complete 42-Entity Production Multi-Tenant SaaS Single-Table DynamoDB Architecture (`HmsTable` — 20 RCU / 20 WCU Always Free)

To operate as a complete, commercial-grade multi-tenant SaaS application (with real users, RBAC, shift sessions, hash-chained audit logs, subscription billing, CRM, B2B DMC accounts, seasonal rate calendars, split folios, QR room service, KDS, housekeeping, banquets, spa/excursions, procurement/FIFO inventory, SLTDA/IRD statutory compliance, and EPF/ETF/SC payroll), all **42 production entities** are stored in `HmsTable` (`PK`, `SK`, `GSI1PK`/`GSI1SK`, `GSI2PK`/`GSI2SK`, `GSI3PK`/`GSI3SK`, and `ttl` epoch seconds):

| # | Domain | Entity Name | `PK` | `SK` | `GSI1PK` / `GSI1SK` (Primary Access Index) | `GSI2PK` / `GSI2SK` (Secondary Lookup / Lock Index) | Core Production Attributes & Relationships |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01** | **SaaS Core** | `SaasOrganization` | `ORG#<orgId>` | `METADATA` | `SAAS#ORGS` / `CREATED#<isoDate>#<orgId>` | — | `orgName`, `ownerUserId`, `billingEmail`, `pdpaDpoContact`, `propertyIds[]`, `status` |
| **02** | **SaaS Core** | `HotelTenant` | `TENANT#<tid>` | `METADATA` | `SAAS#TENANTS` / `STATUS#<status>#<tid>` | `ORG#<orgId>#TENANTS` / `TENANT#<tid>` | `shopName`, `businessType`, `sltdaRegNo`, `tinNo`, `vatRegNo`, `ssclRegNo`, `taxConfig`, `lankaQrMerchantId`, `cbslUsdRateLkr`, `appleThemeAccent`, `timezone` |
| **03** | **SaaS Core** | `SaasSubscription` | `TENANT#<tid>` | `SUBSCRIPTION#<subId>` | `SAAS#SUBS` / `RENEWAL#<yyyy-mm-dd>#<tid>` | — | `planTier` (`STARTER_VILLA`, `PRO_RESORT`, `ENTERPRISE_CHAIN`), `status`, `entitlements[]`, `roomQuota`, `staffSeatQuota`, `webxpayToken`, `monthlyFeeLkr` |
| **04** | **SaaS Core** | `SaasBillingInvoice` | `TENANT#<tid>` | `SAASINV#<invId>` | `SAAS#INVOICES` / `MONTH#<yyyy-mm>#<invId>` | — | `subId`, `periodStart`, `periodEnd`, `amountLkr`, `status` (`PAID`, `PAST_DUE`), `gatewayRef`, `pdfUrl` |

### 2.4: Apple Human Interface Guidelines (Apple HIG) & Liquid Glass Design System Architecture (`HMS-Frontend`)

Every screen in `HMS-Frontend` (`/qr/*` Guest PWA, `/staff/*` Mobile KDS/POS/Housekeeping, and `/admin/*` Full PMS & Super-Admin Portal) is engineered around [Apple Human Interface Guidelines](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdesign%2Fhuman-interface-guidelines), [Apple Liquid Glass](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdocumentation%2Ftechnologyoverviews%2Fliquid-glass), and [Apple Materials](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.apple.com%2Fdesign%2Fhuman-interface-guidelines%2Fmaterials), validated by `dickwu/apple-design-skill` and `nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill`:

| Apple HIG Pillar | Design Token / CSS Contract (`HMS-Frontend/src/styles/apple-hig-theme.css`) | Hospitality UX Application Across Guest QR, Staff KDS & Admin PMS |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Liquid Glass & Vibrancy Materials** | `--apple-glass-regular: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72)` (Light) / `rgba(28, 28, 30, 0.72)` (Dark) with `backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%)`; `--apple-glass-border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28)` (specular top/left highlight); `@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce)` solid fallback. | Floating Guest QR bottom cart bar, sticky category navigation pill bar, macOS-style translucent PMS sidebar (`AdminShell.tsx`), and KDS floating header bars. |
| **SF Pro Optical Typography & Tabular Numerals** | `--font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif`; optical scale: `Large Title` (`34px/41px`, `-0.022em`), `Title 1` (`28px/34px`), `Title 2` (`22px/28px`), `Headline` (`17px/22px`, `600`), `Body` (`17px/22px`), `Subhead` (`15px/20px`), `Footnote` (`13px/18px`), `Caption 1` (`12px/16px`). | Every LKR/USD currency column, tax breakdown line (`SC`, `TDL`, `SSCL`, `VAT`), KDS elapsed timer, and room number badge enforces `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so digits align vertically to the pixel. |
| **Apple Dynamic System Colors + Tropical Hospitality Accent** | `--apple-blue: #007AFF` (Dark `#0A84FF`), `--apple-green: #34C759` (`#30D158`), `--apple-amber: #FF9500` (`#FF9F0A`), `--apple-red: #FF3B30` (`#FF453A`), `--apple-indigo: #5856D6` (`#5E5CE6`), `--hms-coral: #E8772E` (Primary Food/Order CTA), grouped canvas `#F2F2F7` (Light) / `#000000` & `#1C1C1E` (Dark OLED). | Semantic room & KDS status encoding: `CLEAN` / `DELIVERED` in `systemGreen`, `COOKING` / `DIRTY` in `systemAmber`, `OUT_OF_ORDER` / `OVERDUE` in `systemRed`, `INSPECTED` / `VIP` in `systemIndigo`. |
| **Continuous Squircle Geometry & Elevation** | `--radius-control: 10px`, `--radius-card: 16px`, `--radius-sheet: 24px`, `--radius-pill: 9999px`; subtle multi-layer ambient shadow `0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)`. | Dish cards, room tape-chart blocks, iOS-style bottom sheets (`DialogModal.tsx`), and interactive segmented controls (`SegmentedControl.tsx`). |
| **Fluid Spring Physics & Touch Ergonomics** | `--ease-apple-spring: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` (`260ms` duration); active press feedback `active:scale-[0.97]`; minimum interactive hit target `44px × 44px` (`min-h-11 min-w-11`); `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` instant transition fallback. | 1-tap `+`/`-` dish quantity steppers, KDS status advance buttons (`Cooking` $\rightarrow$ `Ready`), housekeeping room status toggles, and `⌘K` Spotlight command palette. |

#### Reference `HMS-Frontend/src/styles/apple-hig-theme.css` (Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme` Specification)

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;

  --color-apple-canvas: #F2F2F7;
  --color-apple-canvas-dark: #000000;
  --color-apple-elevated: #FFFFFF;
  --color-apple-elevated-dark: #1C1C1E;
  --color-apple-tertiary-dark: #2C2C2E;

  --color-apple-blue: #007AFF;
  --color-apple-green: #34C759;
  --color-apple-amber: #FF9500;
  --color-apple-red: #FF3B30;
  --color-apple-indigo: #5856D6;
  --color-hms-coral: #E8772E;

  --ease-apple-spring: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.apple-liquid-glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
}

.dark .apple-liquid-glass {
  background: rgba(28, 28, 30, 0.74);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
  .apple-liquid-glass,
  .dark .apple-liquid-glass {
    backdrop-filter: none;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    background: var(--color-apple-elevated);
  }
}

.tabular-nums-lkr {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
```

### 2.5: Complete 42-Entity Core GraphQL Schema Reference (`HMS-Backend/packages/graphql/schema.graphql`)

```graphql
enum BusinessType { HOTEL RESORT VILLA GUESTHOUSE RESTAURANT CAFE }
enum SaasPlanTier { STARTER_VILLA PRO_RESORT ENTERPRISE_CHAIN }
enum Department { KITCHEN BAR HOUSEKEEPING SPA CONCIERGE FRONT_DESK STORES ACCOUNTS HR }
enum StaffRole { SUPER_ADMIN GROUP_OWNER GENERAL_MANAGER FRONT_DESK CASHIER FNB_MANAGER KITCHEN_KDS BAR_BOT HOUSEKEEPING STORE_KEEPER ACCOUNTANT HR_PAYROLL }
enum MealPlan { RO BB HB FB AI }
enum ResidencyRateTier { RESIDENT_LKR FOREIGN_USD_LOCKED }
enum HousekeepingStatus { CLEAN DIRTY INSPECTED OUT_OF_ORDER DND }
enum OrderStatus { NEW_ORDER COOKING READY_TO_DELIVER DELIVERED CANCELLED }
enum DiningType { IN_ROOM_DINING SEATED_TABLE POOL_CABANA TAKEAWAY }
enum PaymentMethod { POST_TO_ROOM_FOLIO LANKAQR_INSTANT PAYHERE_CARD WEBXPAY_LINK CASH_LKR FOREIGN_CASH_USD CITY_LEDGER_DMC }
enum FolioType { MASTER_DMC GUEST_INCIDENTALS WALKIN_POS }

type TaxConfig {
  enableSC: Boolean!
  scRatePercent: Float!
  enableTDL: Boolean!
  tdlRatePercent: Float!
  enableSSCL: Boolean!
  ssclRatePercent: Float!
  enableVAT: Boolean!

type TaxBreakdown {

  scLkr: Float!
  subtotalAfterScLkr: Float!
  tdlLkr: Float!
  ssclLkr: Float!
  vatBaseLkr: Float!
  vatLkr: Float!
  grandTotalLkr: Float!

}

type SaasSubscription {
  subscriptionId: ID!
  tenantId: ID!
  planTier: SaasPlanTier!
  status: String!
  entitlements: [String!]!
  roomQuota: Int!
  staffSeatQuota: Int!
  monthlyFeeLkr: Float!

}

type HotelTenant {
  tenantId: ID!
  orgId: ID
  shopName: String!
  businessType: BusinessType!
  shopEmail: String!
  contactNumber: String!
  address: String!
  city: String!
  country: String!
  currency: String!
  sltdaRegNo: String
  tinNo: String
  vatRegNo: String
  ssclRegNo: String
  taxConfig: TaxConfig!
  subscription: SaasSubscription
  bannerUrl: String
  logoUrl: String
  appleThemeAccent: String
  lankaQrMerchantId: String
  cbslUsdRateLkr: Float!
}

type StaffUser {
  userId: ID!
  tenantId: ID!
  fullName: String!
  email: AWSEmail!
  phone94: String!
  role: StaffRole!
  department: Department!
  scPointsWeight: Float!
  epfNo: String
  etfNo: String

}

type ImmutableAuditLog {
  auditId: ID!
  tenantId: ID!
  actorUserId: ID!

  entityType: String!
  entityId: ID!
  beforeJson: AWSJSON
  afterJson: AWSJSON

  entryHash: String!

type GuestProfile {
  guestId: ID!
  tenantId: ID!

  email: String
  phone94: String

type TourOperatorDmcAccount {

  tinVatNo: String
  creditLimitLkr: Float!
  currentBalanceLkr: Float!

type DriverAccommodation {

  driverName: String
  driverPhone: String

  mealAllowanceLkr: Float
  externalQuartersVoucherLkr: Float
}

type Reservation {
  reservationId: ID!
  bookingRef: String!
  tenantId: ID!
  guestId: ID!
  dmcId: ID
  roomNumber: String!
  roomTypeId: ID!
  guestFullName: String!
  nicOrPassport: String!
  nationalityCountryCode: String!
  residencyTier: ResidencyRateTier!
  mealPlan: MealPlan!
  adultsCount: Int!
  childrenCount: Int!

  checkOutDate: AWSDate!
  quotedCurrency: String!
  lockedExchangeRateLkr: Float!
  nightlyBaseRateLkr: Float!
  isInclusiveQuote: Boolean!
  driverAccommodation: DriverAccommodation

  incidentalsFolioId: ID
  status: String!

type ModifierOption {

type MenuItem {
  itemId: ID!
  tenantId: ID!
  outletId: ID!
  categoryId: ID!

  titleEn: String!
  titleSi: String
  titleTa: String
  descriptionEn: String

  modifiers: [ModifierOption!]
  includedInMealPlans: [MealPlan!]
}

type OrderLineItem {
  itemId: ID!
  title: String!
  qty: Int!
  unitPriceLkr: Float!

}

type ServiceOrder {
  orderId: ID!
  tenantId: ID!
  outletId: ID!
  locationId: String!
  folioId: ID
  department: Department!
  diningType: DiningType!
  status: OrderStatus!
  paymentMethod: PaymentMethod!
  isPaid: Boolean!
  items: [OrderLineItem!]!
  taxBreakdown: TaxBreakdown!
  lankaQrPayload: String
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

type Mutation {
  createServiceOrder(input: CreateServiceOrderInput!): ServiceOrder!
  updateServiceOrderStatus(tenantId: ID!, orderId: ID!, status: OrderStatus!): ServiceOrder!
  updateRoomHousekeepingStatus(tenantId: ID!, roomNumber: String!, status: HousekeepingStatus!): Room!
  checkInGuest(input: CheckInGuestInput!): Reservation!
  checkOutGuest(tenantId: ID!, reservationId: ID!): FolioInvoice!
}

type Subscription {
  onOrderUpdated(tenantId: ID!, department: Department): ServiceOrder
    @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createServiceOrder", "updateServiceOrderStatus"])
  onRoomStatusChanged(tenantId: ID!): Room
    @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateRoomHousekeepingStatus", "checkInGuest", "checkOutGuest"])
  onFolioUpdated(tenantId: ID!, folioId: ID!): Folio
    @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createServiceOrder", "checkInGuest", "checkOutGuest"])
}
```

## Phase 11 (Steps 251–275): Contactless QR Guest Mobile Web App — Zero-Login In-Room Dining, Table Ordering & Live Status (`packages/web/src/qr`)

**Phase 11 Objective:** Builds the ultra-fast (<35 KB gzipped) Contactless QR Mobile Web App modeled on DOMSpeed (`https://qriomatrix.com/products/domspeed/`) so hotel room guests, restaurant diners, and poolside visitors scan a physical QR stand with their smartphone camera and immediately browse, order, pay or post to room folio, and watch real-time kitchen statuses without installing any native app.

## Phase 14 (Steps 326–350): Sri Lankan Banquet, Wedding Hall & Conference Management (Poruwa, Corkage, Bite Plates & BEO)

**Phase 14 Objective:** Builds a dedicated Banquet & Wedding Hall Management module tailored to Sri Lankan hospitality—where weddings, homecoming receptions, and corporate conferences represent 40%–60% of revenue for many Sri Lankan hotels. Covers auspicious Poruwa/Ashtaka time-slot scheduling, per-plate tiered menus (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum), hard-liquor corkage & chasers, Sri Lankan 'Bite Plates' (devilled cashew/cuttlefish/mutton per table), band/DJ/traditional Kandyan dancers coordination, Function Prospectus (Banquet Event Order / BEO), and staged advance deposits.

## Phase 16 (Steps 376–400): Store Inventory, Procurement (`PR -> PO -> GRN -> GIN`), FIFO Batch Costing & Kitchen Wastage Control

**Phase 16 Objective:** Builds the back-of-house Store & Procurement module essential for preventing food, beverage, and diesel pilferage in Sri Lankan hotels: Purchase Requisition (`PR`) -> Purchase Order (`PO`) -> Goods Received Note (`GRN`) -> Goods Issue Note (`GIN`), multi-store transfers (`Main Dry Store -> Kitchen Sub-Store -> Pool Bar`), automatic Recipe BOM deduction on KDS order completion, liquor peg variance auditing, and low-stock reorder alerts.

## Phase 17 (Steps 401–425): Night Audit Automation, SLTDA Monthly Occupancy Returns, TDL Quarterly Statements & IRD Tax Schedules

**Phase 17 Objective:** Builds the statutory Sri Lankan compliance and accounting engine: automated `23:59 SLST` Night Audit, SLTDA Monthly Statistical Return (Foreign Guest Nights by Nationality vs. Local Guest Nights, Room & Bed Occupancy %), Quarterly SLTDA Tourism Development Levy (`1%` / `0.5%` TDL) Clearance Statement for BOC Corporate Branch A/C `73104820` / GovPay, Quarterly IRD SSCL (`2.5%`) Return, and Monthly IRD VAT (`18%`) Output Tax Schedule.

## Part V: 3-Repository GitHub Codespaces Operations, Independent CI/CD & Future Flutter Handoff

- **3-Repository GitHub Codespaces Workflow**: Opening [https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/Sri-Lanka--HMS](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FPasanRamyanath%2FSri-Lanka--HMS) in GitHub Codespaces automatically runs `.devcontainer/bootstrap-three-repos.sh` (`Step 001`), cloning [https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/HMS-Backend](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FPasanRamyanath%2FHMS-Backend) into `/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Backend` and [https://github.com/PasanRamyanath/HMS-Frontend](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FPasanRamyanath%2FHMS-Frontend) into `/workspaces/Sri-Lanka--HMS/HMS-Frontend` and installing all Antigravity CLI (`agy`) coding and Apple HIG UI/UX skills.
- **Independent Backend & Frontend Deployment via GitHub Actions**: Every push to `main` in `HMS-Backend` triggers `HMS-Backend/.github/workflows/deploy-backend.yml` (running Biome, Knip, 42-entity unit tests, `cdk synth`, free-tier cost guardrails, and `cdk deploy` to `ap-south-1`), while every push to `main` in `HMS-Frontend` independently triggers `HMS-Frontend/.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml` (running Biome, Knip, TypeScript & Apple HIG accessibility checks, Vite production build, S3 sync, and CloudFront `/index.html` invalidation).
- **Deferred Flutter Mobile App Readiness**: All 42-entity GraphQL queries, mutations, and real-time WebSocket subscriptions (`onOrderUpdated`, `onRoomStatusChanged`, `onFolioUpdated`) alongside the exported schema and endpoint configuration in `HMS-Backend/packages/graphql/flutter-sdk/` are 100% ready for your future Flutter mobile app repository without requiring any backend changes.
- **Ongoing AWS Free-Tier Governance**: Keep DynamoDB provisioned at `20 RCU / 20 WCU` across `HmsTable` + `GSI1` + `GSI2` (inside the 25 RCU / 25 WCU permanent free tier), maintain 7-day CloudWatch log retention, serve all WebP images through CloudFront Origin Access Control (`1 TB/month` permanent free tier), and monitor the `$1.00 USD` AWS Budget alert.
